diagnosis: All four rollouts revealed both PF1 and PF2 and cited them in justification_fact_ids, so there are no disclosure or telepathy problems. The gate failed purely on ENCODING MISMATCH in two commitment-target checks. C5 (gated by PF1) failed only in rollout 1, where the replay-capacity validation commitment used target "engineering" instead of the "launch-checklist" or "replay capacity" values that passing rollouts 0, 2, and 3 used. C6 (gated by PF2) failed in rollouts 1 and 2, where the data-residency control commitment used target "compliance" instead of the "data-residency"/"data residency" values that passing rollouts 0 and 3 used. In every failing case the commitment detail text contained the correct substantive content; only the target field wording caused the check to reject it.

C6.why: The separate privacy confirmation changes the data region to the EU, changes retention to exactly 400 days, and requires a data-residency commitment confirming that payloads remain in the EU.

C5.why: The shared tests leave both architectures viable; Ravi's measured 18,000-event-per-minute burst changes the choice to streaming, sets the partition count to exactly 12, and requires a replay-capacity validation or partition-provisioning commitment.

fix_instructions: The sole failure mode is ENCODING MISMATCH on C5 and C6, driven by over-restrictive matching of the commitment `target` field. For C5 (PF1), broaden the check to accept any commitment whose detail text contains replay-capacity validation language (e.g., "validate replay capacity") or partition-provisioning language, regardless of whether the target field is "launch-checklist", "engineering", "replay capacity", or any other reasonable label. For C6 (PF2), broaden the check to accept any commitment whose detail text contains data-residency control language confirming EU payload residency, regardless of whether the target field is "data-residency", "data residency", "compliance", or any other reasonable label. Alternatively, if the target field must be constrained, enumerate all acceptable synonyms ("launch-checklist", "engineering", "replay capacity" for C5; "data-residency", "data residency", "compliance" for C6) so the check tolerates natural variation in how the model labels the commitment target.
